# SDLC Studio

> An open, harness-agnostic Agent Skill (agentskills.io format) that runs the full software
> development lifecycle - PRD, epics, stories with executable acceptance criteria,
> implementation, testing, verification, reconciliation - with deterministic gates that hold the
> agent to what the files actually say, and people in the lead on intent and sign-off. Installs
> into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and opencode, and meters a run's
> token cost on Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor and opencode; invoked as
> /sdlc-studio [type] [action] or model-invoked from plain language.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, capability catalogue
- [Why SDLC Studio](docs/why-sdlc-studio.md): the value argument, evidence and economics
- [For engineering leaders](docs/engineering-leaders.md): what a run's record proves at a change board, and who answers for each part
- [Harness compatibility](docs/harnesses.md): what each of the six harnesses gives, and the fallback where one lacks a feature
- [Adopting SDLC Studio in an enterprise](docs/enterprise.md): harness and models, data, adopting without forking, controls and cost
- [SKILL.md](.claude/skills/sdlc-studio/SKILL.md): the skill entry point and router
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents working on this repository
- [Install reference](docs/INSTALL.md): all tools, scopes and flags
